document.name: NY Kids Club 68th Street Classes
document.shortDescription: Morning enrichment classes on the Upper West Side for babies and toddlers at NY Kids Club 68th Street.
document.longDescription:
NY Kids Club's official Winter/Spring 2026 68th Street schedule PDF lists enrichment classes at 168 Amsterdam Avenue on the Upper West Side with contact phone (917) 708-8440 and email nykidsclub68@nypreschoolandkidsclub.com. The official schedule excerpt lists Musical Tots, Gym Babies, Baby Art & STEM Explorers, and Gym Tots for children from 4 months through 36 months.

The current official snippet shows weekday classes in the morning, including 9:00 AM, 10:45 AM, and 11:00 AM sessions, so this listing uses weekday and morning tags only. This keeps the listing aligned to the schedule details surfaced in the official current PDF result.

Sources: https://nypreschoolandkidsclub.com/68th-street/ https://nypreschoolandkidsclub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/68th-Street-%E2%80%93-Winter_Spring-Enrichment-2.pdf https://dev.nykidsclub.com/wp-content/themes/nykids/images/nykidsclub_logo.jpg
